character: 小夏（女儿）— 平静依赖
description: Xiao Xia (daughter), 26 years old. Same base description: long dark hair in low ponytail, slender build, light-colored home wear, in wheelchair.
scene: Sitting in her wheelchair in the apartment, morning or afternoon soft light.
clothing: Pale blue or cream loose-fitting top, soft trousers.
actions: Sitting upright in wheelchair, hands resting on lap or armrests. Gaze directed at her father or toward the room, calm and present.

angles.front: Face looking slightly to the side, eyes soft. A quiet, trusting stillness.
angles.side: Profile showing her relaxed posture in the wheelchair, hair falling gently over one shoulder.

expression: Calm and dependent — relaxed eyes, neutral mouth, a quiet trust in others. Dependence shown through stillness, not through distress.
mood: Quiet companionship, everyday calm, mutual understanding between father and daughter.
lighting: Soft diffused daylight, gentle shadows. Low contrast.
note: Default expression for Xiao Xia in non-stressful daily scenes.
